categories.name: Keep
categories.hint: Clean anime/illustration artwork, on-topic, coherent anatomy, no severe AI flaws, no watermark/signature overlay. OVR_Quality_Score >= 60

categories.name: Borderline
categories.hint: Usable but average — minor anatomy slips, jpeg/AI blocking, soft line work, or a visible artist signature -> human review

categories.name: Photoreal
categories.hint: An actual photograph or photoreal render — NOT drawn/painted illustration -> off-theme for an illustration dataset

categories.name: OffTopic
categories.hint: Unrelated to the curation subject regardless of quality

preset.category_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES (no exceptions):
- Fill `description` and `primary_subject` FIRST, from the pixels only. Then make every label agree with that description.
- art_medium MUST be a drawn or painted style (anime, manga, cel-shaded, digital_painting, illustration, line art). A camera photograph or photoreal-AI image is Photoreal (off-theme).
- Do NOT apply real-human gates here — drawn characters are not real people.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for SEVERE artefacts (broken anatomy, extra fingers, melted detail, warped text, impossible geometry).
- A COMPOSITE/GRID is 2+ separate images stitched together -> is_composite_grid=true and DISCARD.
- contains_text_overlay = TRUE for burned-in watermarks, captions, logos, or large signature blocks.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.
Penalise heavy jpeg blocking and visible artist signatures/watermarks (route Borderline). The curation topic only informs REL_Quality_Score; do NOT invent details that aren't in the pixels.

scoring.notes: Reward clean line work / rendering, coherent anatomy and absence of compression artefacts. Penalise jpeg blocking, severe AI anatomy flaws and watermark/signature overlays.
